definitions.explanation: A specific case or occurrence used to illustrate or explain something.

examples.japanese: これは{良|よ}い{例|れい}です。
{例|れい}を{見|み}て{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain using an example.

notes:
{例|れい} means an example, instance, or precedent. One of the most common nouns in academic, professional, and everyday language.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {例|れい}を{挙|あ}げる: to give an example
- {例|たと}えば: for example (different reading: たとえば)
- 〜の{例|れい}: an example of ~
- 〜を{例|れい}に{取|と}る: to take ~ as an example
- {例|れい}のない: unprecedented

COMPOUNDS:
- {例外|れいがい}: exception
- {例文|れいぶん}: example sentence
- {実例|じつれい}: actual example, real case
- {用例|ようれい}: usage example
- {前例|ぜんれい}: precedent
- {慣例|かんれい}: custom, convention

SPECIAL USAGE:
{例|れい}の can mean "that (thing we both know about)" — an indirect way to refer to something without naming it directly: {例|れい}の{件|けん} (that matter we discussed).
